Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4689853. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assay_id matching CHEMBL4689853, standard_relation '=', and standard_value not null. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
